parsed.why: Shield law, broad gender-identity protections, X IDs and hate-crime coverage help locally, but national border, passport, facility and custody exposures remain; documented custody harm is dated.
Worst local regime: 2025 facility ban, no gender-identity discrimination or hate-crime law, birth-certificate marker barred, youth-care ban, and solitary-confinement prospect in custody.
Strongest local regime: most-protective tier, statewide gender-neutral restrooms, X markers, self-attestation and shield law; national border and custody rules still cap the score.
Facility ban enforced by complaints with no visitor-usable documentary defence, plus care and flag bans; partial gender-identity protections and amendable state IDs only partly offset.

Sanctuary law, anti-discrimination, hate-crime coverage and restroom court ruling are protective; two recent killings lack denominators, leaving violence frequency unresolved and national regime intact.
